This compilation covers the 'Asset Sale' definition and the sibling defined terms declared in the same §1.01 excerpt: 'Asset Sale Prepayment Event', 'Asset Sale Proceeds Application Period', 'Assignment and Assumption', 'Available Amount', and 'Available Investment Capacity Amount'.

'Asset Sale' itself is a categorical/boundary definition, not a single dollar formula; only the material quantitative carve-outs flagged in the frozen inventory (clauses (d), (x), (cc), (ee), (ff)) are represented with their thresholds - the many purely qualitative carve-outs are bundled into one UNSUPPORTED node rather than guessed at individually, since none carry a stated numeric value.

Cross-references to Sections 6.01, 6.02, 6.03, 6.08, 6.08(a), 6.08(b) (other than 6.08(a)(3) and 6.08(b)(26), which were retrieved) were out of scope per the source-context budget and are not required for the Asset Sale carve-outs' own economics (they gate eligibility of other exceptions, e.g. (b), (c), (u)), which remain UNSUPPORTED/qualitative in this compilation.

'Available Amount' (Section 6.08(a)(3)) and the 'clause (13)' component of 'Available Investment Capacity Amount' were both investigated via getReferencedProvision/getDefinition/getChildren, but each leads into a large, separate builder-basket provision whose full lettered sub-clauses were not retrievable within budget; both are marked MISSING_CONTEXT rather than guessed.

'Asset Sale Prepayment Event' and 'Asset Sale Proceeds Application Period' were successfully resolved via their cross-referenced sections/definitions and are represented with much fuller economics than the bare cross-reference in the original §1.01 excerpt.

'Asset Sale' itself is a categorical/boundary definition, not a single dollar formula; only the material quantitative carve-outs flagged in the frozen inventory (clauses (d), (x), (cc), (ee), (ff)) are represented with their thresholds - the many purely qualitative carve-outs are bundled into one UNSUPPORTED node rather than guessed at individually, since none carry a stated numeric value.

Cross-references to Sections 6.01, 6.02, 6.03, 6.08, 6.08(a), 6.08(b) (other than 6.08(a)(3) and 6.08(b)(26), which were retrieved) were out of scope per the source-context budget and are not required for the Asset Sale carve-outs' own economics (they gate eligibility of other exceptions, e.g. (b), (c), (u)), which remain UNSUPPORTED/qualitative in this compilation.

'Available Amount' (Section 6.08(a)(3)) and the 'clause (13)' component of 'Available Investment Capacity Amount' were both investigated via getReferencedProvision/getDefinition/getChildren, but each leads into a large, separate builder-basket provision whose full lettered sub-clauses were not retrievable within budget; both are marked MISSING_CONTEXT rather than guessed.

'Asset Sale Prepayment Event' and 'Asset Sale Proceeds Application Period' were successfully resolved via their cross-referenced sections/definitions and are represented with much fuller economics than the bare cross-reference in the original §1.01 excerpt.
